description: Run a SQL query and write the result set to a file -- local path or an fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfss://.../abfs://.../az://...). The reverse of a Copy activity whose sink is a file rather than a table.
summary: Run a SQL query and write the result set to a file (local path or S3/GCS/Azure).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key of a registered resource exposing .get_engine() (SQLAlchemy), .get_connection() (DBAPI), or .get_client() (vendor client, e.g. BigQuery/Redshift). Set this OR database_url_env_var (unless dry_run is True, which needs neither).

database_url_env_var.label: Database Url Env Var
database_url_env_var.description: Env var with a SQLAlchemy database URL, read at run time. Set this OR resource_key (unless dry_run).

query.label: Query
query.description: SQL query. Result set becomes the output file's rows.

sink_path.label: Sink Path
sink_path.description: fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfss://..., or a local/plain path) to write the query result to. '{partition_key}' is templated when partitioned.

azure_account_name_env_var.label: Azure Account Name Env Var
azure_account_name_env_var.description: Only used when sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI.

azure_account_key_env_var.label: Azure Account Key Env Var
azure_account_key_env_var.description: Only used when sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI (ignored if azure_connection_string_env_var is also set).

azure_connection_string_env_var.label: Azure Connection String Env Var
azure_connection_string_env_var.description: Only used when sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI. Takes precedence over azure_account_key_env_var.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Log the query and resolved sink_path and skip actually running it -- no resource is looked up, no connection opened, nothing written.

run_window.label: Run Window
run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '09:00-17:00 America/New_York mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of running or failing -- no query runs, no file is written, and real downstream dependents skip too. Checked once per materialization. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool -- a cap on concurrent exports sharing the same pool name. The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level, not here.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-includes 'sql' if empty.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.
